content: I would like to begin by saying how much I love this app. It has really made me think about the world around me and how I interact with it. I feel I take advantage of my environment so much more then what I might have done previously. That said unfortunately the app has a considerable shortcoming. Recently my phone crashed requiring resorting from a previous sync. Having recently backed it up to my laptop I was not too concerned. However on restoring the phone to its previous sync I found that the entire fog of world app had been deleted reset to default settings. All of the data is associated with the phone and not with a profile account that you can log in and out of. This is a huge shortcoming, if like me your phone crashes or if you change your phone. This needs to be addressed in future editions of the app.

author: HChafor

title: Now I have to go out side.
content:
I don't want to be out in the world, but I made the mistake of downloading this app and now I have to actually go out side! 

Like the great Christopher Columbus said "let's go out side and collect fog for some game on the iPhone" and he found America! 

Way to go Sir, way to go!
author: Peacefuljoker

title: Fun little app
content: just something fun to have in your pocket while moving around, could have some better achievements though
author: Luraphage

title: A great app
content:
This is a fun little app that allows you to trace routes across the world and to see where you have been. 

My only complaint with it is that it drains the battery very quickly, which isn't very practical when you are travelling a long distance across a country.
author: Mr Chr15topher

title: Has potential....
content: This is a decent app for travellers or people who like to track where they go all the time, but there are some bugs like the app randomly closing and having areas along the way not being cleared, there should be some way of being able to link un fogged paths together where you have been, but other than this i would recommend this
author: Scouseruk1210

title: Amazing app
content: I have so much fun with this application. Brilliant idea! Now I will always remember where I've been :) It's like leaving a snail trail all over the world. Thank you 👍
author: iPiniu

title: The future of travel apps
content:
This thing is great - records your journey and makes it easy to recall your adventures. This now needs to integrate with something like 'city maps to go' to include the maps and info as well. 

Beware though - you will use battery.
author: Wateryrat

title: Very enjoyable

title: Addictive

author: Carwyn89

title: Great app could be a tad better
content:
Fantastic app! Brilliant idea and was something that I was after. Works really well and doesn't crash etc.
I do feel though that there could be loads more achievements. There also needs to be an option for 'miles' and lastly the way the app 'refreshes' when you're moving - it's very jittery. 
If these few points were updated then it'll be a 5 star review :) defo get this app though! 

Please try and make it not a battery killer.

author: SILΞNT

title: Great idea, nice app, well made
content:
Brilliant little app makes just going round places fun. Acts as a great location history especially if you're going on holiday.

Only 2 gripes: does not reliably stay 'on' in tracking mode when the app is in the background, and uses up a lot of battery. These issues are not present in other apps that track location e.g. Moves.

Otherwise it's really great and worth getting!

title: buh!

author: BIKERBOYUK

title: Good app addition
content:
There's lots going for this but there's also a few thing I don't like. I would like to have the option of removing the fog to get a clear view of the map. I'd also like to see a list if all the trips I've made, and start to finish positions with the ability to add tags. I'd also like to see the distance of each journey with editing options. 

Not only this the idiot who wrote this app is clueless about geography; the UK is a collection if countries not one. So why does it claim I have only visited one when I have been to England and Wales (that's 2 different countries).
author: Jay-Producer

title: Great, apart from one thing...

title: Fantastic

title: Great app, need to address a few issues
content:
Overall, amazing concept, has plenty of potential many of which has already been tapped. Just a few problems and recommendations. 

1. Biggest issue is power, this app drains power like mad when left on. I know there is a message recommending the use of an external gps device but they are relatively expensive atm. 
2. Could add a "journey management" system which enables unique marking of specific journeys which people might want to distinguish from the normal day to day city trips. 
3. Since this app work on the element of nostalgia, maybe a photo import system? Or perhaps not.

title: Not sure what to make of this
content:
I love the idea of the RPG style map, but at the moment the app is just lacking. 

Too small an area is uncovered, so it checks in too often and kills the battery. I'd rather the general area was logged, than just the specific streets. Also, beyond just logging movement, it doesn't really do anything. A bit more of a social side would really help. 

Finally, the map is a bit buggy and refuses to zoom in/out. 

So far, an interesting start, but I'm already getting bored.
